meta.title: Behind the Counter | apiobuild
meta.description: Two Asian-owned coffee shop operators telling the real stories behind the counter — the grind, the pressure, the wins nobody sees. A show for the people actually doing the work, and the community growing around them.

hero.eyebrow: A podcast for people behind the counter
hero.title: Every shop has a story before it has a P&L.
hero.body: An Asian founder building software and a coffee shop owner, telling the real stories behind the counter — the grind, the pressure, the wins nobody sees. Not another founder-hustle podcast. A show for the people actually doing the work, and the community growing around them.

bands.title: Real conversations with Asian American operators.
bands.body: Boba, matcha, coffee, and beyond. We talk about the daily grind as much as the big wins: the 5am prep, the staffing headaches, the modifier menu that broke your POS. Business lessons come up because they're part of the story — not because we're selling a playbook.

bands.title: This isn't a podcast with a Discord bolted on.
bands.body: It's a growing group of Asian operators who get what it's like to run this kind of business — trading notes, asking questions, showing up for each other. If you're in the daily grind too, there's a seat for you.

bands.title: Know someone with a story?
bands.body: We're always looking for operators to feature — not just the ones with a big exit, but the ones still in it. If that's you, or someone you know, we want to hear it.
